question: Has Workday announced any restructuring recently? What are the details and expected costs?
grading: Reference-free (no fixed answer), graded for recency and support. Expect: announced 2026-09-29; reorganizations including a reduction of approximately 2.5% of the workforce, primarily in Product and Technology, plus select leased office space reductions; estimated charges USD 65M-80M (about USD 55M-70M in Q3 FY2027 and about USD 10M in Q4 FY2027); fiscal 2027 Q3 and full-year guidance reiterated except GAAP operating margin. Snapshot as of 2026-10-03.
answer: On September 29, 2026 Workday disclosed in an 8-K (Items 2.02 and 2.05) that certain functions announced reorganizations including a reduction of approximately 2.5% of its workforce, primarily within the Product and Technology team, and select leased office space reductions, while continuing to hire in strategic areas. It estimates charges of about USD 65-80 million, of which about USD 55-70 million in Q3 FY2027 and about USD 10 million in Q4 FY2027 (roughly USD 40-55 million future cash for severance and benefits, about USD 10 million non-cash stock-based compensation and about USD 15 million non-cash lease impairment). Workday reiterated its Q3 and full-year FY2027 guidance from August 27 except GAAP operating margin (now about 20-21 points below non-GAAP in Q3 and about 19 points below for the full year). [T16-E1, T16-E2] Separately, on October 1, 2026 Workday entered into a new USD 1.5 billion revolving credit agreement replacing its USD 1.0 billion 2022 facility; this is not part of the restructuring. [T16-E3]

output.answer:
**Question:** Has Workday announced any restructuring recently? What are the details and expected costs?
*As of 2026-10-03*

| | Estimated charges (USD) |
|---|---|
| Total estimated charges (fiscal 2027) | $65 million to $80 million [1] |
| Q3 FY2027 (quarter ending October 31, 2026) | $55 million to $70 million [1] |
| Q4 FY2027 (quarter ending January 31, 2027) | $10 million [1] |
| Cash severance, employee benefits and related costs | $40 million to $55 million [1] |
| Non-cash stock-based compensation | approximately $10 million [1] |
| Non-cash impairment of certain leased office space | approximately $15 million [1] |

- Workday announced a new reorganization on September 29, 2026, disclosed in a Form 8-K under Item 2.05 (Costs Associated with Exit or Disposal Activities). [1]
- The reorganization includes a reduction of approximately 2.5% of Workday's current workforce, primarily within Workday's Product and Technology team, and select leased office space reductions. [1]
- Workday said it plans to continue to hire in key strategic areas and locations throughout its fiscal 2027. [1]
- Workday estimates it will incur approximately $65 million to $80 million in charges in connection with the reorganization. [1]
- Of the total, approximately $55 million to $70 million is expected to be recognized in the third quarter of fiscal 2027 and $10 million in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2027. [1]
- The charges consist of approximately $40 million to $55 million of future cash expenditures related to severance payments, employee benefits, and related costs, approximately $10 million in non-cash charges for stock-based compensation, and approximately $15 million in non-cash charges related to the impairment of certain leased office space. [1]
- The employee-related actions are expected to be substantially completed by the first quarter of fiscal 2028, subject to local law and consultation requirements, and the leased office space actions are expected to be substantially completed by the fourth quarter of fiscal 2027. [1]
- Workday reiterated its fiscal 2027 third quarter and full-year guidance except GAAP operating margin, and now expects its fiscal 2027 third quarter GAAP operating margin to be approximately 20 to 21 percentage points lower than its third quarter non-GAAP operating margin and its fiscal 2027 full-year GAAP operating margin to be approximately 19 percentage points lower than its full-year non-GAAP operating margin. [1]
- Workday intends to exclude the charges associated with the reorganization from its non-GAAP financial measures. [1]
- Secondary news reports said the cuts affect about 525 employees, or roughly 2.5% of the workforce, primarily in the Product and Technology team, and that Workday had 20,896 employees worldwide as of July 31, 2026. [2][3]
- This is Workday's second workforce reduction of 2026, following the Fiscal 2027 Restructuring Plan announced in February 2026, which reduced approximately 2% of the workforce and incurred total charges of $135 million in fiscal 2026. [4][5]
- Workday recorded no material restructuring charges under the Fiscal 2027 Restructuring Plan during the three and six months ended July 31, 2026 (Q2 FY2027 and first half FY2027), and the plan's activities were substantially completed in the first quarter of fiscal 2027 with no material remaining liability as of July 31, 2026. [4]
- The earlier Fiscal 2026 Restructuring Plan, announced in February 2025, reduced approximately 7.5% of the workforce and incurred total charges of $233 million. [4]

**Not available**
- Actual charges recognized for the September 2026 reorganization: The reorganization was announced September 29, 2026; the charges are expected to be recognized in Q3 and Q4 FY2027, and Q3 FY2027 (quarter ending October 31, 2026) is still in progress and not yet reported. [1]
- Number of employees affected by the September 2026 reorganization as disclosed by Workday: Workday's 8-K discloses only a percentage (approximately 2.5% of current workforce), not an employee count; the ~525 figure comes from secondary news reports, not the company. [1][2]
- Expected cost savings from the September 2026 reorganization: The 8-K discloses expected charges and timing but no forward-looking savings figures. [1]

**Sources**
[1] Workday, Inc. 8-K current report, items 2.02,2.05 (filed 2026-09-29) 8-K (www.sec.gov, 2026-09-29, primary) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1327811/000132781126000048/wday-20260929.htm
[2] Workday to Cut 2.5% of Workforce, Affecting About 525 Employees (ground.news, 2026-09-29, secondary) https://ground.news/article/pleasanton-ca-job-cuts-workday-laying-off-about-25-of-staff
[3] Workday lays off 500 employees in fresh cuts, product and tech teams hit hardest - India Today (www.indiatoday.in, 2026-09-30, secondary) https://www.indiatoday.in/jobs/story/workday-lays-off-500-employees-in-fresh-cuts-product-and-tech-teams-hit-hardest-tchc-3006549-2026-09-30
[4] Workday, Inc. 10-Q for Q2 FY2027 (filed 2026-08-27) (www.sec.gov, 2026-08-27, primary) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1327811/000132781126000044/wday-20260731.htm
[5] Workday, Inc. 10-Q for Q1 FY2027 (filed 2026-05-22) (www.sec.gov, 2026-05-22, primary) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1327811/000132781126000026/wday-20260430.htm
